name: Mariya Naruse
source:
Maria is [url=https://vndb.org/c152961]Mio[/url]'s maid, but she has never seen her that way. To her, she is more like a younger sister who is always nearby. [url=https://vndb.org/c152960]Jin[/url] adopted her, and she became part of my family, just as close as Mio. Honestly she even reminds [url=https://vndb.org/c144566]me[/url] of [url=https://vndb.org/c144575]Nixie[/url] — both are very sweet and shameless.
